title: The Rune Stone
text: A standing stone carved with runes stands half sunk in the turf, lichen in the cuts. Some say the runes change each time you look, and they do: when you look back, the last line names one of you.

options.label: The wisest reads the runes, and the name on the last line.

outcomes.text: It is a warning about the road ahead, one they will not forget.
It is a curse on whoever reads it, and they have read it.

options.label: Take a rubbing to sell to scholars, without looking at the last line.

outcomes.text: Scholars pay well, and they do not ask whose name is on it.

options.label: Topple the stone so it can name no one else.
